summary: The image contains two line charts titled 'Utility Progression Over Iteration Steps' comparing LLM-based and Template-based methods. Both charts display utility values on the y-axis against iteration steps on the x-axis, ranging from 0 to 40 steps. Each line represents a different data series, showing how utility progresses over time. The LLM-based chart shows a more gradual increase in utility values, while the Template-based chart demonstrates a steeper initial rise. These charts illustrate the differences in utility progression between the two methods, highlighting variations in performance and efficiency over the iteration steps.
